searchText: This effort looks really interesting. I’m wondering whether the instrumentation approach here could be extended or repurposed to evaluate performance in a zkVM context. Obviously, not all metrics would translate directly, and the units might need to shift (e.g. wall-clock time → cycle count/constraint cost), but at a high level, this feels like a potentially useful direction. cc: <@774033563732541451> <@427491045308235776> Ref: https://hackmd.io/@jsign/eth-zisk-air-cost-reth-ethrex Thats the current plan 🙂 We currently re-use the same benchmarking test cases too nice!
